text:
Predicates:
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
Game(y) ::: y is a game.
Top10(y) ::: y is on the Top 10 list.
MadeBy(x, y) ::: x made y.
SoldOver(x, y) ::: x sold more than y copies.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.
InList(y) ::: y is included in the list.
Premises:
Created(legendOfZelda, gameCompany) ∧ Game(legendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda was created by a game company.
∀x (Game(x) ∧ MadeBy(x, y) → JapaneseGameCompany(y)) ::: All games on the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
∀x (SoldOver(x, 1,000,000) → InList(x)) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it will be included in the Top 10 list.
SoldOver(legendOfZelda, 1,000,000) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.
Conclusion:
¬InList(legendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda is not on the Top 10 list.
